summary: Art's-Way Manufacturing filed an 8-K disclosing a $956,000 term loan (Laser Loan) with Bank Midwest, entered October 5, 2026, to fund a fiberoptic laser and crane system for its Agricultural Products Segment, replacing a 2007 CO2 laser. Interest is fixed at 6.65% for the first 60 payments beginning October 30, 2026, then 1-month SOFR plus 3.1% for 120 payments; initial monthly payment $8,456. The same filing reported quarterly results for the three and nine months ended August 31, 2026. This is a routine financing and earnings filing, not a special situation.
